hero.title: Clear cargo from Egyptian ports without the bureaucracy.
hero.lead: Takhlees connects importers with licensed clearance agencies, holds payment in escrow, and surfaces every customs milestone the moment it happens. Submit a shipment, watch it move, pay on release.

items.title: Verified, not vouched
items.body: Every agency on the platform exposes its commercial license number, port coverage, and review history. You verify trust against the data, not against a badge.

items.title: Escrow, not handshake
items.body: Pay into escrow at submission. Funds release to the agency only when your container is released to you. Disputed clearances return your money.

items.title: Status, not status updates
items.body: Every milestone — gate-in, declaration filed, customs cleared, released — lands in your dashboard the moment it happens. No more phone calls to ask where things stand.

flow.title: From submission to release, in three moves.

items.title: Submit
items.body: Upload your bill of lading, commercial invoice, and packing list. We pull the container number and ETA automatically.

items.title: Match
items.body: Pick from licensed agencies covering your port. One confirms inside twelve minutes on average and the file enters their queue.

items.title: Release
items.body: The agency files the customs declaration; you watch each milestone clear in real time, with the fee held in escrow until cargo is released.

reach.title: Live across Egypt's three primary ports.
reach.body: Alexandria, Damietta, and Sokhna handle the overwhelming majority of container traffic into and out of the country. Each site has licensed agencies on the platform with active clearances in progress right now.

about.heroTitle: Built so cross-border trade can finally move at internet speed.
about.heroLead: We're a team of operators, engineers, and logistics veterans building the trust layer between importers, exporters, and the clearance specialists who move their cargo through Egyptian ports.

mission.title: Clarity at every step of port clearance.
mission.p1: Port clearance has historically been opaque — phone calls, lost paperwork, unclear pricing. We're building the digital infrastructure that brings it into the open: vetted partners, transparent fees, and a single dashboard from “submitted” to “released.”
mission.p2: We started Takhlees because we lived this problem ourselves. Importers shouldn't lose deals waiting on faxes. Clearance specialists shouldn't spend half their week chasing payments. And no one should wonder where their cargo is.

trust.title: Trust
trust.body: Every company on the platform is verified before going live.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.body: Fewer phone calls. Less chasing. One dashboard for everything.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Clear pricing, real-time status, and reviews from real clients.
